items.title: Lorraine Feather interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 22, 2023
items.q: I got this awesome call to sing with Petula Clark in Vegas for a couple of weeks and wear beautiful outfits and be with an orchestra.

ctx.x: Just two, so you sort of did it by ear or did you have a producer involved?

I think we just did it by ear. The other gig I had in that period of time was with Petula Clark in Vegas. And somehow or other I got this job. Oh what happened was I had been waiting around for this acting audition for a showcase that paid nothing. There was a line around the block. And all of a sudden I just went, “I can’t take this anymore.” I had been singing in clubs a little bit, and I went home to my then-boyfriend and I said, “I’m not an actress anymore, okay? I’m a singer. I can’t take it, I just can’t.…
